_readme: Demo venue layout for AI Crowd Guardian, based on the Circuit de Monaco (Monaco Grand Prix). Built from publicly available spectator/grandstand guides, not an official circuit document. Gate-to-grandstand mappings and zone shapes are simplified for a hackathon demo. capacity_per_min, distance_m and width_m are illustrative placeholders — tune these against whatever the demo needs to show before presenting. Grandstands are grouped by shared entrance gate rather than modeled individually, to keep the zone count demo-friendly.
venue_name: Circuit de Monaco - Monaco Grand Prix

zones.name: Gate 1 - Le Rocher (General Admission)
zones.notes: Entrance for Le Rocher, a hillside general-admission viewing area outside the circuit itself.

zones.name: Sainte Devote (Turn 1)
zones.notes: Circuit's narrowest, most accident-prone corner. Pinch point between Gate 1 / Zone Z crowds and the harbour-side grandstands.

zones.name: Zone Z (General Admission)
zones.notes: Unreserved standing zone near the Tabac corner, close to Sainte Devote.

zones.name: Monaco Monte-Carlo Train Station
zones.notes: Largest single crowd-injection point. Feeds directly into Gate 8 via a pedestrian tunnel. Strong candidate for a 'train arrival' shock event.

zones.name: Gate 8 - Grandstand K1-K3
zones.notes: Below the train station stairs. Grandstand K overlooks Port Hercule between the Tabac corner and the Piscine chicane.

zones.name: Gate 7 - Grandstand K4-K6
zones.notes: Second entrance for the K grandstand, closer to the Louis Chiron / Piscine chicane end.

zones.name: Port Hercule Harbour Promenade
zones.notes: Main pedestrian spine along the harbour, connecting Gates 2, 7 and 8 and Grandstands K, N, O, P, V. Highest-traffic corridor in the venue - primary bottleneck candidate.

zones.name: Gate 2 - Grandstands N, O, P, V
zones.notes: Harbourfront grandstands built over the water, facing the Piscine (swimming pool) section.

zones.name: Casino Square - Grandstand B
zones.notes: Viewing area at the Casino corner. High footfall from cafes, restaurants and the fan zone walk.

zones.name: Fan Zone - Place d'Armes
zones.notes: Free public fan zone with big screen, food and drink. No ticket required, so inflow is the least predictable zone in the venue.

zones.name: Gate 3 - Grandstands T1-T3
zones.notes: Entrance near the Nouvelle Chicane / pit straight hospitality stands.

zones.name: Gate 5 - Grandstand L
zones.notes: Grandstand L overlooks the exit of the Piscine chicane, facing Le Rocher.

zones.name: Fontvieille Egress / Post-Race Exit
zones.notes: Main post-event egress route away from the harbour, toward parking and the Fontvieille district.
